acculturation.def: When a group adopts some traits of another culture while keeping its own culture.

assimilation.def: When a group takes on another culture so fully that its own traits fade away. It may be chosen or forced.

syncretism.def: The blending of traits from two or more cultures into a new form, such as a festival or religion that neither culture had before.

multiculturalism.def: Many cultures living side by side in one society, each keeping its own traits; also a policy that supports this.
